title.narrative: Investing for Impact against Tuberculosis and HIV - South Africa (01-Apr-2016-31-Mar-2019)

description.narrative: South Africa, TB/HIV, Right to Care (RTC - Centurion Office)This program has the following goals: Ensuring an enabling and accessible legal framework that protects and promotes human rights in order to support implementation of the NSP. Initiating at least 80% of eligible patients on antiretroviral treatment, with 70% alive and on treatment five years after initiation. Reducing new HIV infections by at least 50%, using combination prevention approaches. Reducing self-reported stigma related to HIV and TB by at least 50%. Reducing the number of new TB infections and deaths from TB by 50%. The objectives of this program are: Addressing Social and Structural Drivers of HIV and TB Prevention, Care and Impact. Ensuring protection of human rights and improving access to justice. Preventing New HIV, STI and TB Infections. Sustaining Health and Wellness
